title: Irrational series II Summation by packages
summary: Discrete sums of exponentials $g(w) = \sum a_β \mathrm{e}^{βw}$ with positive exponents may converge not normally in neighborhoods $H$ of $-\infty$ which do not contain half-planes. We study different notions of convergence for these series and in particular the intuitive notion of summation by packages. Indeed, joining in packages the terms in the sum $g(w)$ whose exponents are close together, and summing first inside each package may result in massive cancellations.
